name: Buckshot Dwarf
flavour: Short fuse. Shorter legs. Very long gun.
art_prompt: a squat grotesquely obese dwarf, twice as wide as he is tall, with a huge bushy black beard, a bulbous purple-red nose, tiny mean glowing red eyes under a dented black iron helmet with a spike, a dark crimson tunic under a black studded leather apron stretched over an enormous belly, a bandolier of brass shells, holding at his hip an absurdly huge black double-barrelled blunderbuss shotgun longer than he is tall with flared barrels as wide as his arms, stubby legs, huge black boots, an evil grin with a gold tooth, standing on the ground
motion: stomping in place with heavy short steps, the giant shotgun bouncing at the hip, belly and beard wobbling, glaring
doc: Stage 1's other gun: a fat, evil dwarf with a blunderbuss longer than he is tall who waddles in to five metres, well inside the cactus's reach, and fires five pellets in a cone (a red wedge on the ground for most of a second). Twice the cactus's health; the answer is to step out of the wedge, not away.

BD-0.note: the top-level strip, before the Level Editor's looks

recipe.art_prompt: an extremely wide, squat Wild West desert bandit, almost as wide as he is tall: enormous shoulders, a round belly, thick short arms, extremely short legs and small feet in compact brown leather boots; a thick bushy black beard, a dark burgundy bandana over his nose and mouth, narrow angry eyes under thick eyebrows; an enormous dark espresso-brown sombrero with a cream triangle pattern round its wide flat brim; a heavy dark-magenta poncho with bold cream zigzags and beige fringe, cream shirt sleeves, thick dark-brown gloves, a brown belt with a brass buckle, baggy charcoal-brown trousers; an absurdly oversized simple gunmetal shotgun with a wide round muzzle, brass bands and a dark wooden stock held diagonally across his body in a marching carry, stock down-left at the hip, barrel up-right above his shoulder
recipe.motion: stomping in place with heavy short steps, the huge shotgun held diagonally across his body bouncing with each step, the poncho fringe and beard swaying, glaring
recipe.back_hint: Exactly the same physical pose rotated 180 degrees: the shotgun's barrel now sticks up past his LEFT shoulder (up-left) and its wooden stock out at the lower RIGHT behind his hip (down-right); the gun stays in front of him, partly hidden by his torso and poncho, only the protruding barrel and stock visible from behind. The back of the dark-magenta poncho shows one big cream zigzag stripe in a wide V above the beige fringe; the knot of the burgundy bandana and the black hair at the back of his head under the sombrero; no face. Consistent anatomy and weapon alignment.
recipe.dead_hint: lying flat on his back sideways across the frame with his head to the left, knocked out: eyes shut, his huge sombrero tipped off his head beside him, the big shotgun lying across his round belly, his short legs limp; no ground, no sand

BD-A.note: pass 70: the Bandit from Garry's turnaround (tools/dl/uploads/2d/bandit.png): the front painted from its front half with his words (front_from_picture, stills bda); the back and the dead edited from it, his back-view words as back_hint; free Wan clips front and back like BD-0
